free_tier.stated: No free tier. A 3-day test costs EUR 1.98 and then renews at EUR 5.98 a month unless cancelled; a 14-day money-back guarantee applies to regular plans.
free_tier.notes: The test is paid, not free: 'Why does the test cost EUR 1.98?'

retention.stated: Over 4,000 days (more than eleven years) in every plan

egress.terms: Unlimited traffic and full speed on every plan

interface_detail: NNTP over TLS/SSL; the vendor says a newsreader such as SABnzbd or NZBGet is needed
chaining: Two plans only (monthly and yearly) with the same 100 connections; the yearly price is the cheapest unlimited plan of this vendor and works as a primary behind which a block account on another backbone fills gaps.
limits_note: Monthly EUR 5.98, yearly EUR 3.98 a month, prepaid EUR 6.98 a month or EUR 4.98 a month for a year; the vendor says the price stays for life.
binding_note: Traffic and speed are unlimited, so the 100-connection ceiling is the only technical bound the vendor states.

identity_cost.detail: The test order asks for 'E-mail, country, payment method'; payment is by SEPA direct debit, credit card, cryptocurrencies or iDEAL/Wero, so a card is not the only route. Fields of the regular checkout were not read: unverified: behind a sign-up.

reliability_note: The backbone is not stated on the vendor pages read; completion is unmeasured.
confidence_note: Prices, connections, retention and test terms are from the vendor pages read on 2026-11-03.
